Your first souvenir from the Moon. §6Moon Turf§f is the dusty regolith that covers lunar surfaces and low-gravity rocky planets. Gray, gritty, and completely useless for crafting, but you need to prove you've been there.

Can't be crafted. You have to land on a Moon dimension, mine it with any pickaxe, and bring it back. It's the first real milestone of any planetary exploration campaign.

The Moon Turf kicks off the alien planet materials chain. After this come Hot Turf, Basalt, Geodes, Crystals, and the rest of the planet-specific blocks. Each one requires a dedicated mission to a different world.

§ePS:§f Land on the near side of the Moon for the densest regolith deposits. A Monopropellant Rocket Engine is enough for a one-way trip. Just make sure you have fuel for the return.
